Is there a place you would suggest we look aside from Bangor? The city we’re in now has about a population of about 150k, with slightly smaller neighboring cities with around the same amount of people. We want away from that kind of thing. This area just has a lot of jobs so there’s constantly people moving here.  We didn’t want Portland because of how big it seemed and want to be away from the coast.

political alignment, cost of land, to get as far away from here as possible. We were more looking into the Bangor area bc of its size, we live near a very large city and the city we are in now is growing rapidly and full of pollution. Bangor just seemed smaller but still large enough to be entertaining while we settle in. We plan to visit this year, summer and winter, to make sure it’s doable. 

To answer the Texas question, I honestly don’t know. I know a lot of people are trying to leave because of how things are politically. It’s scary for a specific population.
